department: Paul M. Rady Department of Mechanical Engineering

deadline.value: International PhD applications are due December 1 by 10:00 p.m. MST (domestic December 10); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: International applicant deadline: December 1 by 10:00 p.m. MST

gre_general.value: The Graduate School lists no GRE requirement for Mechanical Engineering.
gre_general.quote: 303-492-4717 MS, PhD, Professional MS (no direct MS admissions, applicants must apply to ProMS) GRE not required

supervisor.value: Reach out to faculty during the application; an advisor match is not required at application.
supervisor.quote: We recommend that prospective PhD students begin reaching out to faculty of interest during the application process. | While we don't require an advisor match at the time of application

funding.value: Funding is offered to all admitted PhD students, mainly through research assistantships with an advisor.
funding.quote: We offer funding to all PhD applicants whom we admit.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; many students enter directly from undergraduate study.
entry_route.quote: You do not need a master's degree to be admitted to this program. Many of our students enroll directly from their undergraduate institution.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Aerospace Engineering Sciences is a separate PhD department (deadline Dec 1) and is not covered. English minimums follow the university default.
